purpose: One diagnostic-only Android 12 candidate based on physically tested r1/r3 behavior. Preserve the r1 70 MHz AIC behavior, Image, boot, DT, userspace and 21 unrelated modules while adding a read-only post-START_APP-timeout CCCR interrupt snapshot to aic8800_bsp.ko.
decision_scope: Distinguish no persistent AIC card interrupt-pending indication from a pending interrupt lost before the AIC SDIO handler; not a Wi-Fi fix, not Android 16 Prototype A r3 and not physical-test authorization.

observed_fields: timeout SDIO function number, MMC_CAP_SDIO_IRQ, host sdio_irq_pending, IRQ claim and handler state
post-timeout read-only CCCR INTx value/return followed by IENx value/return
preserved: physical r1 boot.fex, Linux 5.4.302 Image, ramdisk, DT and boot AVB bytes
r1 Android 12 system_a, vendor_a, product_a and userspace bytes
r1 DTBO, vendor_boot, bootloader, TEE and vbmeta payloads
LP metadata, extents, group limits and three metadata slots
21 unrelated module bytes, their expected exported-symbol CRCs and all static vendor_dlkm files
r1/r3 70 MHz AIC runtime clock behavior, original START_APP timeout and all pre-timeout control flow
m8b-remote-r1 input, physical r1/r3 candidates and Test8r2 rollback image
changed: START_APP-gated r3 trace plus one post-timeout read-only CCCR snapshot in the pinned AIC8800 BSP
after the existing timeout only: one host claim, CCCR INTx then IENx CMD52 reads, host/core state capture and one compact summary
vendor_dlkm AVB hashtree/FEC and containing super.fex extent
offline_limitations: Instrumentation does not change or prove Wi-Fi behavior and is not a fix.
A clear INTx only proves that no standards-compliant pending indication survived until timeout; it cannot exclude an earlier transient or self-cleared assertion.
Only a separately authorized physical run can collect the snapshot; this candidate does not authorize flashing or open Gate 2.
